obernants.operator: Let N be total input bytes, L the line count and B selected bytes. Extraction takes O(N+L+B) time: text.lines scans the entire input, including excluded text. Its auxiliary memory is O(L+B); the whole prep call also retains the raw input, so extraction-stage retained memory is O(N+L+B). Sentence scan takes O(n+sum token bytes); output adds O(Bout) time/storage, plus opaque annotator and token storage costs. These bounds assume finite valid UTF-8 and successful allocation; no measured timing prediction.
